# Theme scope (candidate minor theme); prefers same distance band and compact jurisdictions.

	value = 100

		limit = {
			exists = scope:oe_kat_lead
			has_variable = oe_theme_distance
			scope:oe_kat_lead = { has_variable = oe_theme_distance }

		add = 30
	}
}
